author: Shadowbladz
body:
Avicus has a real problem with ghost client users. In my eyes every team, no matter who has atleast 1-2 closet cheaters. I hope this can be the first step in dealing with one of Avicus' problems

Name of Player being reported: Ciyh otherwise known as Cuish or Sam
Rule broken: Client modification (ghost client)
Evidence:

Ciyh has been uploading lots of videos recently to try to get the CC rank, however this has also meant a lot of evidence of him using an aim adjustment hotkey is available now. These videos are uploaded in 720p60fps. Please watch in 60fps and with 0.25 speed, it highlights the speed/accuracy of some of these flicks and also the impossibility of them. I've bolded any of the ones I feel are especially obvious.

https://youtu.be/ybL-i4MP0fQ
First video of his I watched. Forget about the fight with Ciaan, focus on the second one.
0:16 - Ciyh toggles or uses a hotkey to correct his aim twice in this fight, once obviously, one less so. The obvious one being the autocorrection for when his aim slides off to the left and then locks back onto the hitbox. Then again his aim slides to the bottom left of the hitbox and then flicks back on. The part of the 2nd lock that gives it away is how his aim continues with intertia in the direction it was going before the aimlock.

https://youtu.be/swYCNUkTNMU
1:14 - aim flicks over a player and then locks back onto him
2:39 - aim slides off to the left and then locks back on to the centre of the hitbox this time.

https://youtu.be/l2GYb4mFnpo
0:57 - His aim slows down possibly indictating running out of mousepad, and suddenly flicks stupidly fast yet accurately towards a player
2;25 - He's shot around a corner, and then his aim smoothly moves onto the centre of the hitbox before returning to being imperfect and human

https://youtu.be/WPgDu89Xd5Y
0:18 - aim locks onto dead body mid flick for a very short amount of time before flicking over fully
0:45 - Maraka's head actually locks onto his teammate besides him shortly, but that's for another player report 

https://youtu.be/t-WzfviNP-k
0:26 - aim lingers over body+head when he aims over them, before resuming normal movements
1:49 - aim very smoothly moves onto the hitbox

https://youtu.be/JpIhdgurKls
1:16 - aim flicks back onto a player very quickly 

Personally I think he may also have started autoclicking by some of his bridging/block placing, and also may have a soft aimbot by some of his tracking, but this isn't as easily proven as these aimlocks, so here you go




Anything else you would like to add? Was attempting to handle this privately with an admin while I was on the same team as Ciyh, but now that I'm not might aswell make this open to a wider discussion
